artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Erasmus of Rotterdam, displaying his upper body and head in profile, facing right. It shows his distinguished forehead, prominent nose, and pronounced chin. He wears a soft cap, partially covering his hair, with a few strands visible. Erasmus is dressed in a cloak with a fur collar. There is a sculptural bust with another profile facing right with curly hair. The background includes text that says "ERASMVS ROTERODAMVS" and other inscriptions, adding to the historical and scholarly context. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Baptism
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures, showing their bodies from head to mid-thigh. The central figure stands in a river with arms crossed over the chest. They have a gentle facial expression with long hair and a beard, while a cloth is draped loosely around the waist. To the left, a figure is kneeling in the river, wearing a brown garment with horizontal stripes and a rope tied around the waist, and pouring water over the central figure's head. This person has a full beard and curly hair. The third figure, on the right, stands with one hand resting on the shoulder of the central figure, clothed in a red robe with long blond hair and a small crown on the head. In the background, billowing blue clouds fill the sky above a green landscape, enhancing the serene setting.

artworks.title: Antique Shop
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of an entrance to an open area, potentially a courtyard, surrounded by buildings. The architecture features large rectangular windows, giving a sense of height and structure. The horizon is obscured by the facades of the buildings in the background. The artwork showcases detailed etching with a focus on line work to depict texture and detail, particularly in the windows and rooftops. The color scheme is monochromatic, using only black and white tones to enhance the dramatic and historic atmosphere. The foreground includes an entrance with various objects, leading the viewer's gaze further into the scene to explore the architectural elements. In the distance, the alleyway and buildings are depicted with shading and fine lines, creating a visually rich composition.

artworks.title: Adriaen van Ostade
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of a man with his arms crossed, looking slightly to his right. He wears a broad-brimmed hat, and his hair reaches his collar. He has prominent cheekbones and slightly narrowed eyes, and wears a collared garment with large cuffs. In front of him is a nude child figure interacting with a large sheet of paper or artwork. The surroundings include a shelf with a bottle and a framed image, all set against a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Sylvester (Douglas) Lord Glenbervie; Katherine Anne (North) Glenbervie; Frederic (North) Earl of Guilford; Frederic Sylvester Douglas
artworks.medium: lithograph, four portraits printed on one sheet
artworks.description: This image is a composite of four sketched portraits, each showing the upper half of the individuals in a seated position. The first portrait, in the upper left, depicts Katherine Anne (North), Lady Glenbervie. She is seated with her body turned toward the viewer, and her facial features include large eyes and delicate lips. Her hair is covered by a bonnet with frills and a feather. She wears a high-collared dress with intricate detailing on the sleeves. The second portrait, in the upper right, features Sylvester (Douglas), Lord Glenbervie. He sits sideways with his body angled to the right, displaying features like a strong nose and a high forehead with sparse hair. He is dressed in a formal coat and vest. The third portrait, on the lower left, is of The Honorable Frederic Sylvester Douglas. His hair is neatly styled, and he wears a buttoned coat. Lastly, the fourth portrait on the lower right showcases Frederic (North), Earl of Guildford. He is seated facing forward with a relaxed demeanor, his hair parted. His attire includes a double-breasted coat and gloves. The background for all portraits is plain.

artworks.title: Four Magistrates of Besançon (Quatre magistrats de Besançon)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal scene set within a decorative framework. The image depicts four figures dressed in historical attire, each seated on ornate chairs underneath a draped canopy. The heraldic emblem featuring a double-headed eagle sits atop the tapestry. The figures appear to be engaged in a discussion or debate, with one gesturing towards the others.

artworks.title: Courthouse Portal, Rothenburgh
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate doorway with steps leading up to it. The drawing depicts a detailed and intricately carved entrance, showcasing architectural elements including archways and decorative stone carvings. The steps leading up to the doorway are uneven. A lantern hangs from a wrought iron bracket. The textures in the drawing highlight the ruggedness of the stone and the elaborate designs.

artworks.title: Abside de l'église de Saint-Nectaire
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is not clearly visible, with the focus on a church situated on a hill surrounded by hilly terrain. Additionally, there are cottages dispersed among rolling hills closer to the viewer. The lithograph depicts detailed and somewhat soft brushstrokes, blending natural forms and architecture harmoniously. The color scheme is predominantly monochromatic, using shades of gray to portray depth and form against a cloud-streaked sky.

artworks.title: Souvenir de St. Valéry sur Somme
artworks.description: The image shows a boat on the shore, with buildings and other boats in the background. Human figures are visible nearby. The sky above has swirling, textured clouds in shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: Ornament with Foliage and Birds
artworks.artist: Bartolomeus van Lochom after Hans Janssen
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures surrounded by intricate floral designs and animals. The image features detailed swirling patterns that fill the frame with vines and flowers. Amongst these, birds can be seen perched on branches. Below, the two figures are depicted in period clothing, facing each other, framed by the floral backdrop. Animals, like a squirrel and a dog, can be spotted within the design. The entire composition is reminiscent of intricate 16th or 17th-century engravings or woodcuts, with a decorative border enclosing the imagery.

artworks.title: Handle for Knife or Fork, Ornamented with Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative scabbard design. The ornate scabbard features intricate designs of nature, architecture, and classical figures. The top segment includes a small animal surrounded by floral scrollwork. Below it, a scene depicts figures in elaborate attire underneath an arched structure. Another section features a central classical figure holding scales. The lower portion is adorned with more scrollwork, flanked by symmetrical birds. The overall style is richly detailed and suggests a mix of allegorical and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Handle for Knife or Fork, Ornamented with Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate vertical panel with intricate designs. The panel is decorated with elaborate scrollwork featuring mythical creatures and narrative vignettes confined within two main sections. The top section depicts figures gathered around a centrally placed figure, possibly engaged in a ritual by an altar or fire. The middle section contains a motif, possibly a heraldic lion amidst swirling patterns. The bottom section shows two figures in an interior setting, one seated and another possibly reading. Decorative flourishes with stylized birds and beasts frame the scenes, suggesting an ornamental art style used for architectural or functional objects.

artworks.title: William Hayley
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with light-colored, wavy hair, wearing a double-breasted coat and a white high-collared shirt with a tied cravat.

artworks.title: Edmund Burke
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a seated position. His face is turned slightly to his left with a calm expression. He has a moderately full face with distinct features, including a pronounced nose and rounded cheeks. His hair is wavy, worn in loose curls that fall around his head. The man is dressed in formal attire, including a dark coat with buttons, a vest, and a white cravat. The background is neutral and softly textured, highlighting the subject without any other elements or scenery.

artworks.title: Susannah Crouching
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with watercolor, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image depicts two nude female figures seated next to each other on a draped cloth. Both figures are shown in full body view. The figure on the left is seated with her legs bent and crossed, leaning slightly to her left, while one arm rests across her chest and the other is laid across her abdomen. The figure on the right is seated in a more reclined position with knees bent up towards her chest, one arm resting on her knee, and the other across her chest. Both figures appear to be nestled against a neutral-toned drapery that serves as a background, with soft, muted colors and shadows casting depth around them.

artworks.title: Miss Kemble in a White Dress
artworks.artist: John Jones after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, looking slightly to her left. She has a calm expression with delicate facial features. Her hair is styled in intricate curls and waves, and she is wearing a high-necked garment with ruffles and bows. In front of her is a ledge decorated with floral motifs, and the background is muted and monochrome.

artworks.title: Zephyr
artworks.description: The image features two figures. The figure on the left is seated with a side view visible, extending from the head to the feet. This person appears to be sitting on the ground with one knee raised and an arm positioned near the head, surrounded by flowing drapery and grass. Their hair is styled with sticks or pins, and the features are faintly sketched, providing little detail on facial characteristics. They are wearing loose, flowing garments. The figure on the right is captured in motion, with most of their body visible, seemingly dancing or leaping with one leg raised. This person is depicted in partial profile and holds a cloth or veil as they move. Their hair is styled, possibly in a bun or bunch. The scene conveys a sense of movement and grace, set in an outdoor field with sketch lines suggesting grass and minimal background details. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held aside from the cloth. The background is simple and unadorned, primarily focused on the figures themselves.

artworks.title: Viva Andalucia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in motion, with her arms extended and one leg lifted. She has focused facial features and dark hair styled with a feather. She wears an elaborate dress with ruffles and a textured design. She also wears beads or a necklace. The background is plain, and there is a signature and edition number at the bottom.

artworks.title: Swallows
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dancers in a dynamic pose. The image shows two figures engaged in an expressive dance on grassy terrain. The technique includes fine linework and shading that suggest movement, fluidity, and spontaneity. The background is minimal, with light strokes hinting at clouds and birds in flight. The composition conveys grace and elegance with attention to the dancers' postures and expressions.

artworks.title: Cover of the Fourth Yearbook of the Artist Group the Brucke
artworks.description: The image shows a graphic artwork of part of a face, specifically the right side with the eye, cheek, and nose on a red background. The facial features are depicted in a bold, angular style typical of expressionist woodcut prints, with an emphasis on strong lines and contrast. The hair is abstract and cropped. The person appears unclothed. The background includes abstract shapes and figures, alongside text at the top and bottom reading "BRÜCKE 1909" and "Schmidt - Rottluff," with the initials "ELK" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Head of van de Velde, Bright (Kopf van de Velde, Hell)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a man's face depicted in a bold, graphic style. The man's face is the primary focus, with only his head and neck visible. His head is large in proportion to any background elements and is depicted with strong, exaggerated lines and a stony texture that emphasizes facial features. The hair is styled in a neat, combed look, although the distinct lines give it an abstract quality. He has a long, rectangular face and deep-set, weary eyes that look forward. The man's clothing is not clearly detailed, except for a suggestion of a collar or neckline. The background consists of angular shapes that resemble buildings and mountains. The entire composition is monochromatic, using only varying shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Der Verliebte (The Loved One)
artworks.description: The image displays a circular shape with intricate lines and forms. Inside the circle is a figure resembling a reclining human silhouette with elongated limbs. The figure is composed of geometric shapes and intersecting lines. Below the circle is a smaller rounded shape, resembling a wheel or pedal. The composition is abstract with textured areas and shadows adding depth.
